facts.fact: Gabonmediatime reports that a 35-year-old man was remanded in Libreville central prison for sharing an AI-generated video parodying the president's resignation, charged under Penal Code articles 157 ff. on insulting the head of state, after arrest by the DGR.

GAB.note: No government use of AI is stated.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
